Edge Cases Test Page

This page contains various edge cases that should NOT trigger detection

1. Hidden Field

Hidden input with name="otp" - should NOT be detected (not visible)

2. Password Field

Password field - should NOT be detected (excluded pattern)

3. ZIP Code

ZIP code with numeric input - should NOT be detected (excluded pattern)

4. Disabled Field

Disabled verification field - should NOT be detected (disabled)

5. CSS Hidden Field

Field with display:none - should NOT be detected (not visible)

6. Email Address

Email field - should NOT be detected (excluded pattern)

7. Search Box

Search input - should NOT be detected (excluded pattern)

8. Credit Card CVV

CVV code - should NOT be detected (excluded pattern)

9. Phone Number

Full phone number - should NOT be detected (excluded pattern + length)

10. Zero-Size Element

Field with zero dimensions - should NOT be detected (not visible)

Expected Result: No verification field should be detected on this page. All inputs are either hidden, disabled, or match exclusion patterns.
